newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey tenders for $2-bln coal-fired power plant.
newsitem.headline: Turkey tenders for $2-bln coal-fired power plant.

text.p: Turkey invited tender bids to build a coal-fired power plant in the east that would cost about $2 billion and produce about eight billion kiloWatthours (kWh) annually, the Official Gazette said.
It said Turkey's state power authority TEAS would collect bids for Afsin Elbistan-B thermal power plant from international companies until April 29, 1997.
Companies will bid for four power generation units each having 350 MegaWatt (MW) capacity as well as desulphurisation units to be attached to the chimneys, it said.
The plant will be similar in output capacity and size with a nearby existing one operating in the region in Kahramanmaras province.
The region's lignite reserves are estimated at 3.5 billion tonnes -- half Turkey's total lignite capacity -- which can supply three more plant that can totally produce up tp 50 billion kWh a year.
